title: Scam

author: Imicek89

title: Got scammed!
body: I downloaded Habio app and not only I was charged 34,99€ for a membership, I also was charged 2 additional charges of 29,99€ (x2) for some downloadable workbooks that I DID NOT ORDER! Contacted customer support twice, got rejected and so I spent 95€ for nothing. I am so mad, never trusting apps like this again.
author: janebeata

title: Scam Scam Scam !!!!!
body: I decided to try the trial for 1€ but instead, I got charged for 30€. Not once but twice. I have uninstalled the app since and I still got charged. So please for your own good DO NOT install this app. It’s nothing but a scam. When I had it installed, it did not let me get to the premium content either way. so, just save your money, and rather buy a planner.

title: Absolutely horrible
body: The app does not have any of the features advertised (like management for ADHD or reading tool for ADHD) and takes money directly through your card after trial period i.e. you cannot go through Apple to request a refund because they have no knowledge that you have been charged. Do not download, it is a scam.
